ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Producers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Tertiary consumers

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Sanitation/ PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Sanitation/ PRACTICES.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Sanitation/ PRACTICES.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Sanitation/ PRACTICES.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Sanitation/ PRACTICES.

3. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. joule (J)
   C. watt (W)
   D. newton (N)

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Dressing ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)

   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dressing ENVIRONMENT.

   D. Guess results without recording observations on Animals ENVIRONMENT.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Home ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying : OUR SCHOOL? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on : OUR SCHOOL.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about : OUR SCHOOL.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for : OUR SCHOOL.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to : OUR SCHOOL.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT.

9. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Weather ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather ENVIRONMENT.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Hand washing PRACTICES? (1 mark)

12. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Iron rusting

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Water ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Soil ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
